sources.prompt:
Use the attached images only as style references: match the painterly look, fine grain, cold stone masonry, half-timbering, night palette and warm amber lantern light of the harbour scene (first image) and of our harbour facades (second and third images). Do not copy their composition.

Paint ONE isolated background layer for a 2.5D night harbour town, seen straight from the front like an architectural elevation (camera at eye level, no perspective tilt, no vanishing lines): a continuous row of five narrow townhouses lining a quiet back street, spanning the full width of the image, three storeys tall plus their roofs, filling about the lower 75% of the image. Scale: a person is about 170 pixels tall in this image; doors are about 200 pixels tall. Street level, from left to right: a cobbler's shopfront with an ivory canvas awning and a lit window display, a plain house door with a hanging lantern, a narrow tavern with a lit bow window, a closed carriage gate, a herbalist's door with bunches of dried plants. Half-timbered upper storeys with warm lit windows and dark ones, one balcony with flower boxes, steep slate roofs with dormers and chimneys, house heights varying by about one storey; wall lanterns glowing warm amber at door height; one plain cloth pennant in veil blue without any mark. The bottom edge of the image is a straight horizontal line at the foot of the walls, with no ground, no steps and no cobbles in front.

Everything around the subjects (above the roofs, between the panels, around the objects) is a perfectly flat, uniform pure magenta (#FF00FF) background with no shading, no texture, no sky, no clouds, no moon, no distant city.

Strictly no people, no text, no letters, no numbers, no signature, no watermark, no logos, no playing-card suit symbols, no emblems on any cloth.

Style bible: stylized HD-2D, theatrical; night with near-monochrome indigo and slate dominant, cold grey stone as secondary, warm amber lantern light, desaturated ivory for canvas and highlights; the four family colours (ember orange, veil blue and silver, bramble green, star gold) only on banners and small accents; props concentrated at focal points, never uniform clutter; world of a harbour city where people challenge each other at card duels.
